subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic lifecycle approval policy and require an additional explicit operator approval?
rationale: The exception intentionally changes workflow behavior introduced three days earlier, while the proposed three-line and 50% threshold is product policy rather than a dependency or established format contract.

options.title: Gate low-continuity updates
options.body: Require explicit approval only for low-continuity replacements while substantially continuous updates retain automatic approval.

options.title: Preserve unconditional automatic approval
options.body: Reject structurally invalid skill bodies but allow every structurally valid update to follow the existing automatic approval policy.

options.title: Require approval for every update
options.body: Move all Skill Workshop updates behind an explicit operator gate, accepting the broader workflow regression for a simpler safety rule.

recommendation.title: Gate low-continuity updates
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only for low-continuity replacements while substantially continuous updates retain automatic approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and verified the automatic-approval behavior whose permanent exception requires confirmation.
